name: theme
title: Opaline Theme
description: Minimal, premium design tokens — Apple system typography, neutral palette and glass materials for light and dark.

name: liquid-glass
title: Liquid Glass
description: The primitive behind every glass component. Refracts the backdrop through an SVG displacement map, with a frosted fallback.

name: glass-dock
title: Glass Dock
description: macOS-style dock with smooth magnification and hover labels.

name: glass-text
title: Glass Text
description: Headlines cast in liquid glass — every glyph is a bevelled lens with rim light and a travelling sheen.

name: glass-control-center
title: Glass Control Center
description: macOS-style Control Center kit — glass modules, toggles, light-filled sliders and buttons.

name: glass-segmented
title: Glass Segmented
description: Icon segmented picker whose glass bubble stretches like liquid as it travels.

name: glass-date-picker
title: Glass Date Picker
description: Glass calendar with a gliding day bubble, and a capsule date picker.

name: glass-stepper
title: Glass Stepper
description: Capsule stepper with rolling digits, hold-to-accelerate and a shake at the limits.

name: glass-context-menu
title: Glass Context Menu
description: Right-click menu that springs from the cursor, with a row of round quick actions.

name: glass-widget
title: Glass Widget
description: iOS home-screen widget frame on liquid glass — small, medium and large.

name: glass-widget-weather
title: Weather Widget
description: Weather widget with animated condition art and an hourly forecast.

name: glass-widget-calendar
title: Calendar Widget
description: Calendar widget showing today, what's next and a month at a glance.

name: glass-widget-battery
title: Battery Widget
description: Batteries widget with device rings that fill, turn red when low and show charging.

name: glass-button
title: Glass Button
description: Pill button made of liquid glass with a pointer-tracked highlight.

name: glass-lens
title: Glass Lens
description: Draggable magnifying lens that bends whatever is beneath it.

name: glass-sidebar
title: Glass Sidebar
description: Floating source list with a sliding glass selection and icon-only mode.

name: glass-command
title: Glass Command
description: ⌘K command palette on a frosted glass sheet, powered by cmdk.

name: glass-player
title: Glass Player
description: Now-playing widget with scrubber, transport controls and volume.

name: glass-card
title: Glass Card
description: Frosted card surface with header, content and footer slots.

name: glass-knob
title: Glass Knob
description: Rotary dial with a glass cap — drag around it or use the arrow keys.

name: glass-clock
title: Glass Clock
description: Analog clock on a liquid glass face with a sweeping second hand.

name: glass-stack
title: Glass Stack
description: A deck of glass cards — swipe the top one away to reveal the next.

name: glass-switch
title: Glass Switch
description: iOS switch whose thumb turns into a glass lens while pressed.

name: glass-slider
title: Glass Slider
description: Slider whose thumb becomes a refracting lens while dragging.

name: glass-tabs
title: Glass Tabs
description: Segmented control with a glass bubble that glides between tabs.

name: glass-tab-bar
title: Glass Tab Bar
description: Floating iOS 26 tab bar with a sliding liquid selection.

name: glass-sheet
title: Glass Sheet
description: Floating side sheet, or a drag-to-dismiss bottom drawer with side="bottom".

name: glass-toast
title: Glass Toast
description: Imperative toasts on glass that drop in from the top.

name: glass-popover
title: Glass Popover
description: Rich popover content on a frosted glass surface.

name: glass-select
title: Glass Select
description: Capsule select with a frosted glass option list.

name: glass-menu
title: Glass Menu
description: Dropdown menu rendered on liquid glass.

name: glass-dialog
title: Glass Dialog
description: Modal on a frosted glass sheet with springy transform-only motion.

name: glass-notification
title: Glass Notification
description: iOS notification banner plus a stack that fans out on hover.

name: glass-input
title: Glass Input
description: Capsule text field with icon and adornment slots — made for search.

name: glass-toolbar
title: Glass Toolbar
description: Floating capsule toolbar that groups icon actions.

name: glass-tooltip
title: Glass Tooltip
description: Capsule tooltip that springs out of its trigger.

name: glass-badge
title: Glass Badge
description: Small glass chip with an optional glowing status dot.

name: glass-otp
title: OTP Input
description: One-time code cells on glass with a gliding lens, paste and SMS autofill, and success / error states.

name: all
title: Everything
description: The Opaline theme and every component in one install.
